/bin/bash -lc 'task_tmp=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR%/}/gdc-pages.XXXXXX")
printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$task_tmp"
base='"'https://gwpgckandhla.in'
for path in '/' '/our-courses/' '/no-of-seats/' '/department/' '/contact-us/' '/history/' '/vision-mission/' '/syllabus/' '/documents/' '/wp-json/wp/v2/pages?per_page=100'; do
  safe="'$(printf '"'%s' \""'$path" | tr -cs '"'A-Za-z0-9' '_')
  if curl -k -L --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 30 \""'$base$path" -o "$task_tmp/$safe.html"; then
    printf '"'\\nPAGE %s bytes=' \""'$path"; wc -c < "$task_tmp/$safe.html"
    printf '"'TITLE/TEXT MATCHES\\n'
    rg -in -C 3 'Govt|Government|Women|Kandhla|Kandh|Shamli|course|program|B\\.A|B\\.Com|B\\.Sc|M\\.A|M\\.Com|M\\.Sc|degree|subject|eligib|duration|admission|seat' \""'$task_tmp/$safe.html" | head -180
  else
    printf '"'\\nPAGE %s FETCH_FAILED\\n' \""'$path"
  fi
done'

Vision & Mission
Vision
To educate, enable and empower rural girls and to transform them into a socially responsible and professionally successful individual.
To achieve special recognition for our institution at district, national and international level.
Mission
To provide quality education to girls and to inculcate scientific temper, creative skills, ethical values, humanism and curiosity amongst young girls and broaden the horizons of their intellect through various curricular, co-curricular and extra-curricular activities.
To motivate students for self-employment and for employment in public and private sectors so that they can contribute in social and economic development of the nation.

CREATE TABLE streams (
    id    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    slug  TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    name  TEXT NOT NULL,
    intro TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq);
CREATE TABLE books (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    title       TEXT NOT NULL,
    author      TEXT,
    url         TEXT,
    description TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE institutes (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name        TEXT NOT NULL,
    city        TEXT,
    website     TEXT,
    description TEXT
, source_id TEXT, district TEXT, state TEXT, institution_type TEXT, institution_type_source_url TEXT, institution_type_confidence TEXT, institution_type_notes TEXT, institution_type_verified_at TEXT);
CREATE TABLE job_sectors (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name        TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE node_books (
    node_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES career_nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    book_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES books(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (node_id, book_id)
);
CREATE TABLE node_institutes (
    node_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES career_nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    institute_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES institutes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (node_id, institute_id)
);
CREATE TABLE node_job_sectors (
    node_id       INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES career_nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    job_sector_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES job_sectors(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (node_id, job_sector_id)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "career_nodes" (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    slug      TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    stream_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES streams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    parent_id INTEGER REFERENCES "career_nodes"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    name      TEXT NOT NULL,
    intro     TEXT
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_books_title ON books(title);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_institutes_name ON institutes(name);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_job_sectors_name ON job_sectors(name);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_institutes_source_id
            ON institutes(source_id)
            WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_institutes_location
            ON institutes(state, district, city);
CREATE TABLE institute_courses (
            id                  INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            source_id           TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
            institute_id        INTEGER NOT NULL
                                    REFERENCES institutes(id)
                                    ON DELETE CASCADE,
            name                TEXT NOT NULL,
            level               TEXT NOT NULL,
            credential          TEXT,
            specialization      TEXT,
            duration            TEXT,
            mode                TEXT,
            eligibility         TEXT,
            official_course_url TEXT NOT NULL,
            verification_status TEXT NOT NULL
        , mapping_gap TEXT);
CREATE INDEX idx_institute_courses_institute
            ON institute_courses(institute_id);
CREATE TABLE course_career_nodes (
            course_id      INTEGER NOT NULL
                               REFERENCES institute_courses(id)
                               ON DELETE CASCADE,
            node_id        INTEGER NOT NULL
                               REFERENCES career_nodes(id)
                               ON DELETE CASCADE,
            relation       TEXT NOT NULL,
            confidence     TEXT NOT NULL,
            mapping_status TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (course_id, node_id)
        );
CREATE INDEX idx_course_career_nodes_node
            ON course_career_nodes(node_id);
CREATE TABLE institute_categories (
            institute_id INTEGER NOT NULL
                             REFERENCES institutes(id)
                             ON DELETE CASCADE,
            category     TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (institute_id, category)
        );
CREATE TABLE institute_rankings (
            institute_id      INTEGER NOT NULL
                                  REFERENCES institutes(id)
                                  ON DELETE CASCADE,
            system            TEXT NOT NULL,
            year              INTEGER NOT NULL,
            category          TEXT NOT NULL,
            nirf_institute_id TEXT,
            rank              INTEGER,
            rank_band         TEXT,
            score             REAL,
            source_url        TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (institute_id, system, year, category)
        );
CREATE INDEX idx_institute_rankings_order
            ON institute_rankings(year, category, rank, rank_band);
CREATE INDEX idx_institutes_type
            ON institutes(institution_type);

Information Collection And Use

Types of Data Collected

Cookies and Usage Data

Legal Requirements
Government Women P.G. College may disclose your Personal Data in the good faith belief that such action is necessary to:

Security Of Data

Service Providers

Changes To This Privacy Policy

Vision

To educate, enable and empower rural girls and to transform them into a socially responsible and professionally successful individual.

To achieve special recognition for our institution at district, national and international level.

Mission

To provide quality education to girls and to inculcate scientific temper, creative skills, ethical values, humanism and curiosity amongst young girls and broaden the horizons of their intellect through various curricular, co-curricular and extra-curricular activities.

To motivate students for self-employment and for employment in public and private sectors so that they can contribute in social and economic development of the nation.

Principal's Message

Dear Students,

Thank you for choosing our college and congratulations on receiving an offer to study here. We view the social and cultural diversity of our students, staff and partners in the professions and the community as a key strength. This diversity has created a vibrant and rich learning environment that prepares graduates for a borderless workplace. Your achievements must be good for yourself, your parents, your future, the country, and the world. To do this requires a wide range of qualities, some you already have, and others you will soon develop. To name a few: devotion; good judgment; hard work; motivation; optimism; resilience; responsibility; self confidence; sense of purpose, etc. You also have to be prepared to respond to the challenges that lie ahead. Try your best to show your teachers (and also your fellow students) that you are willing to overcome difficulties. In turn, you should be prepared to change your life style and mind set to adapt to college life, for example: you should become more independent, more proactive, more tolerant, more open minded and more mindful of things going on around you.  Success at this level not only depends on gaining knowledge and memorizing facts. It also depends on how well you can use the things that you learn. The skills you learn in college can be transferred to your everyday life and future. In my view, that is also part of academic excellence. Martin Luther King said “The function of education is to teach one to think intensively” and to think critically “Intelligence plus character is the goal of education”. This is what we hope to offer you at this college. The college is keen to ensure realization of the full academic and personal potential of all students. The staff at this college, is dedicated to help you develop these skills. I wish you all the best in your pursuit of knowledge, and expect that you will go beyond the boundaries in this endeavour.

 ” Arise, Awake and Stop not till the goal is reached.”

With best wishes.


Principal
